Basically a damn commie for most people I guess. Extremely socially progressive and mostly liberal (in the lefty sense, because here in France "liberal" means right/conservative) as far as economics go. Some questions about corporations had me nearly laughing. But yeah basically I think it's silly how some people get to hoard tons of wealth, and then use that wealth to buy power to get more wealth. It's a vicious circle. Corporations shouldn't be worshipped, they should be tools to advance society. CEOs shouldn't be idols, they should be praised when they do something right though, but "something right" isn't blindly generating more profits. Corporations should have a "social duty" towards society and mankind as a whole, not just a "profit duty" towards their shareholders. They should be profitable but not on a gigantic level, and not at the expense of things like the environment or the well-being of their employees/workers.

As far as social policies go, my position is simpler (and very liberal again) : if it doesn't harm other people, I don't care what you're doing in your private life. Homosexuality, porn, marijuana, you can guess my stance on most of these issues with that mantra. Same with religion : you're free to believe in whatever you want and to have your own moral values, but not to impose them on others. It means that religions should be taught about in schools (in middle or high school, as part of history courses) but no religion class. Except if it's to discuss them honestly and with an open mind. It's entirely in your right to not eat pork (and politely ask your child's lunch not to include any as respect for your belief), it's silly to try and prevent anyone from ever drinking alcohol because you consider it a sin.

As far as the poll is concerned, it lacks a question about Universal Basic Income if you ask me though, as well as questions about the environment.

What are the rules about earning the ability to "upvoat?"
At the start you can upvoat only 10 times per 24h. Once you get 20 comment contribution points (CCP), you have unlimited ability to upvoat. Every time someone upvoat your comment, you earn 1 CCP.
Also to add, you can't downvoat until you hit those 100 upvoats. So essentially once you've reached 100 CCP you're unlimited with ups and downs.
